analysis.headline: Broadening Participation Beyond Tech as Value, Health Care, and European Equities Strengthen
analysis.market_regime: Rotation into Value and Defensive-Cyclicals Amid Tech and Emerging Market Moderation
analysis.executive_summary: Quantitative signals indicate shifting relative leadership away from growth and technology themes toward value, health care, materials, and European equities. U.S. Large-Cap Value (IWD) leads Growth (IWF) with positive 20-bar and 63-bar spreads, while Health Care (IXJ, XLV) and European exposures (FEZ, EWQ, VGK) show strengthening relative momentum. Emerging markets (EEM, EWZ, EWY) and semiconductor themes (SMH) reflect deteriorating relative strength across both short and long horizons.

emerging_rotations.title: Medical Devices Rebounds Strongly
emerging_rotations.explanation: IHI moved into an EMERGING state with a score of 79.07, driven by a 5-bar score change of +39.44 and 20-bar relative strength of +11.24 percentage points versus SPY.

emerging_rotations.title: South Africa Leadership Rebounds
emerging_rotations.explanation: EZA posted a 20-bar score change of +51.16 to reach a score of 62.87, accompanied by 20-bar relative strength of +5.45 percentage points over ACWX.

emerging_rotations.title: U.S. Materials Gaining Momentum
emerging_rotations.explanation: XLB reached a score of 77.73 in an EMERGING state, posting a 20-bar score change of +53.64 and 20-bar relative strength of +2.64 percentage points relative to SPY.

accelerating_rotations.title: Global Health Care Accelerates
accelerating_rotations.explanation: IXJ displays positive relative strength on both horizons (+3.08 percentage points over 20 bars and +9.89 percentage points over 63 bars) with a 5-bar score change of +27.0 to reach 81.5.

accelerating_rotations.title: Ireland Equities Gain Velocity
accelerating_rotations.explanation: EIRL achieved an ACCELERATING state with a score of 77.07, supported by a 5-bar score change of +24.51 and 63-bar relative strength of +8.76 percentage points versus ACWX.

persistent_leaders.title: Singapore Maintains Longest Streak
persistent_leaders.explanation: EWS maintains a leader zone streak of 27 bars with a score of 89.39 and positive relative strength across 20 bars (+4.59 percentage points) and 63 bars (+16.38 percentage points) relative to ACWX.

persistent_leaders.title: Eurozone Blue Chips Lead Developed Region
persistent_leaders.explanation: FEZ holds top rank in EXUS_REGION with a score of 86.88 and a 7-bar leader zone streak, showing +3.14 percentage points in 20-bar relative strength versus ACWX.

persistent_leaders.title: Cloud Computing Retains High Scores
persistent_leaders.explanation: SKYY retains rank 1 in US_INDUSTRY_THEME with a score of 84.26 and a 9-bar leader streak, supported by 63-bar relative strength of +21.2 percentage points versus SPY.

reaccelerating_rotations.title: Small Caps Turning Upward
reaccelerating_rotations.explanation: IWM reaccelerated to rank 1 in US_MARKET_BREADTH with a score of 73.33 and a 5-bar score change of +16.67, holding a positive 63-bar relative strength of +0.81 percentage points versus ITOT.

reaccelerating_rotations.title: Developed ex-US Rebounds
reaccelerating_rotations.explanation: VEA reaccelerated with a 5-bar score change of +3.57 to a score of 70.71, supported by positive 20-bar (+0.31 percentage points) and 63-bar (+0.12 percentage points) relative strength versus ACWX.

weakening_rotations.title: Cybersecurity Shows Short-Term Fatigue
weakening_rotations.explanation: CIBR remains at a high score of 82.04 but shows score deterioration with a 5-bar score change of -1.67 and a 20-bar score change of -9.26, despite strong 63-bar relative strength (+28.08 percentage points vs SPY).

weakening_rotations.title: U.S. Financials Deteriorate from Peak
weakening_rotations.explanation: XLF fell to a score of 70.45 with a 20-bar score change of -23.18 and 5-bar score change of -4.09, though 63-bar relative strength remains positive (+8.83 percentage points vs SPY).

rotation_out.title: Brazil Weakens Across Horizons
rotation_out.explanation: EWZ fell into ROTATION_OUT with a score of 23.29, declining by -22.8 points over 5 bars and exhibiting negative 20-bar (-8.34 percentage points) and 63-bar (-14.33 percentage points) relative strength versus ACWX.

rotation_out.title: South Korea Relative Strength Drops
rotation_out.explanation: EWY recorded a score of 21.1 and a 20-bar score change of -35.49, with negative relative strength over both 20 bars (-8.15 percentage points) and 63 bars (-16.34 percentage points) versus ACWX.

rotation_out.title: Semiconductors Enter Rotation Out
rotation_out.explanation: SMH sank to a score of 15.19 with a 20-bar score change of -37.41 and negative relative strength across 20 bars (-7.05 percentage points) and 63 bars (-5.08 percentage points) relative to SPY.

geographic_rotations.title: Eurozone Leadership Strengthens
geographic_rotations.explanation: Eurozone equities (FEZ) lead regional groups with a score of 86.88 and 20-bar score improvement of +31.88, confirmed by country-level leadership in France (EWQ, score 83.66) and Ireland (EIRL, score 77.07).

geographic_rotations.title: African Equities Rebound Relative to Broad EM
geographic_rotations.explanation: South Africa (EZA, score 62.87) and broader Africa (AFK, score 64.38) show improving short-horizon rotation, contrasting with broad Emerging Market weakness in EEM (score 30.71).

pair_relationships.title: Large-Cap Value Leading Growth Pair
pair_relationships.explanation: In direct pair analysis, Value (IWD) leads Growth (IWF) with a score of 71.21, a 5-bar score change of +9.44, and a positive 20-bar spread vs IWF of +4.39 percentage points and 63-bar spread of +10.12 percentage points.

pair_relationships.title: Equal Weight Leading Cap Weight Pair
pair_relationships.explanation: Equal Weight (RSP) leads Cap Weight (SPY) with an EMERGING pair score of 61.77, supported by a 20-bar spread vs SPY of +0.90 percentage points and a 63-bar spread of +4.11 percentage points.

cross_market_confirmations: Health Care leadership is confirmed globally (IXJ, score 81.5) and in U.S. sectors (XLV, score 85.45) as well as sub-industries (XPH, score 82.41; IHI, score 79.07).
Value preference is confirmed across style pairs (IWD leading IWF) and equal-weight pairs (RSP leading SPY).
European developed market leadership is confirmed at the regional level (FEZ, VGK) and country level (EPOL, EWQ, EIRL).
risks_or_conflicts: Long-horizon technology strength in CIBR (+28.08 percentage points 63-bar RS) conflicts with short-horizon weakness in semiconductors (SMH, score 15.19).
Emerging market breadth is fractured: EZA and AFK show positive 20-bar relative strength while major members EWZ and EWY suffer severe relative deterioration.
analysis.methodology_note: Interpretation uses deterministic 5-bar score changes, 20- and 63-bar relative strength or pair spreads, and persistence metrics. ETF volume and CMF are treated as market-participation indicators, not fund-flow data.
